Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team found the latency and cost numbers convincing. We need to get a concrete mutual action plan (MAP) in place so we can align procurement and infra timelines. High level asks from our side:

- Dedicated vs Private (VPC) tradeoffs for PHI workloads
- Expected lead times for committed GPU pools (H100/other) and typical staging buffer
- Suggested pool sizing for 50k monthly active users with a peak QPS fingerprinting workload
- What evidence you can share for SOC2 / audit readiness to support our security review

We have a procurement kickoff next Tuesday and would like a draft MAP that ties evaluation milestones to purchase triggers. Can you put something together by EOD Monday? If not, please propose an earliest realistic delivery.

Thanks,

Helix Therapeutics

Ari —

Appreciate the clear asks. We'll draft a MAP that maps evaluation gates to reservation commitments and outlines lead times. Quick answers inline while we prepare the doc: 

- Dedicated vs Private: Dedicated (Redwood-managed reserved GPU pools) gives fastest time-to-live and is the simplest procurement route. Private (VPC/on-prem) is available but adds provisioning lead time (networking + KMS + compliance handshake).

- Lead times (typical):
  * Dedicated: 4–8 weeks from signed commitment to production-ready pool (depends on tranche size).
  * Private (VPC with customer-managed network): 8–14 weeks (longer if cross-account networking or HSM integration needed).

- Sizing suggestion for 50k MAU with peak fingerprinting: initial tranche 8 H100 equivalents (staggered): 4 for staging/validation, 4 for production; plan a 25% buffer for peak. We'll include cost/latency tradeoffs when we share the MAP workbook.

- SOC2: I attached a two-page SOC2 overview (high level) and will include a redaction-friendly evidence list in the MAP. We can follow a SOC2 evidence handoff workflow if you want us to engage security for a deeper review.

Deliverable plan:
- Monday EOD: draft MAP spreadsheet (gated milestones + decision triggers) — we will attach a MAP_Helix_v0.2.xlsx.
- Tue (procurement kickoff): 30-min sync with procurement/tech review to walk the MAP and timing assumptions.
- By Fri: finalize MAP with agreed staging buffer and reservation tranches.

Looping in Lauren (account lead) to help with the procurement checklist and Ben (solutions) for the sizing validation.

Best,
Jonas Weber

Jonas / Lauren —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarifying items from procurement and security:

1) We need explicit acceptance criteria at each MAP gate. Procurement will only approve a purchase trigger if the evaluation gate is green and SOC2 evidence checklist has assigned owners.

2) For Private/VPC option: what are the additional recurring costs we should expect (eg egress, cross-account NAT, additional monitoring, connector licensing)?

3) Lead times: 4–8 weeks for Dedicated is promising. Can you break that down (hardware allocation, network setup, validation)? Also provide an accelerated path if we agree to three-month tranche commitments vs annual.

4) Attachments: please send the MAP spreadsheet and a single-source SOC2 evidence manifest we can share with our compliance team (redaction-friendly).

We'd like to keep the MAP compact — procurement prefers a one-page milestone summary with appendix.

Regards,
Procurement Ops
Helix Therapeutics

Thanks — see below for the concise MAP summary and next steps (attaching the MAP workbook as well). I'm keeping the one-pager summary as the top-level milestone list per your preference.

MAP summary (top-level milestones):

1) Milestone: Evaluation Gate — P0 latency & cost sanity check
  - Owner: Helix Eng (validation), Redwood Solutions (Ben)
  - Criteria: 95th percentile tail latency < 200ms for 2k QPS synthetic fingerprinting; generation cost delta within 15% of PoC run
  - Target date: +2 weeks from today (2027-06-08)

2) Milestone: Security Review — SOC2 evidence handoff
  - Owner: Redwood Security (primary), Helix Compliance (review)
  - Criteria: Evidence manifest delivered + two redaction-safe artifacts (audit log sample, encryption config)
  - Target date: +10 days (2027-06-04)

3) Milestone: Commitment Decision — reservation triggers
  - Owner: Helix Procurement + Helix Exec (approve), Redwood AE (Jonas)
  - Criteria: green on Eval + Security; tranche size and pricing approved
  - Target date: +3 weeks (2027-06-15)

4) Milestone: Provisioning & Validation
  - Owner: Redwood Infra + Helix Eng
  - Criteria: Staging pool live, smoke tests passing, KV/prefix cache validated
  - Target date: Dedicated path: +4–8 weeks post-commit; Private (VPC): +8–14 weeks post-commit

Sizing & tranche suggestion: start with an 8 H100-equivalent tranche (4 staging, 4 production), with a follow-on tranche of 4 after the first month if the production signal meets the expected MAU/QPS conversion. For an accelerated path (3-month financial commitment), we can compress the timeline by ~1–2 weeks on Dedicated via prioritized allocation.

Costs & Private delta: Private adds network egress risk and integration engineering (~$X–$Y/month estimate — workbook has ranges). We'll also include a high-level ops uplift estimate in the appendix.

Artifacts attached: MAP_Helix_v0.2.xlsx (milestones, decision triggers, gantt), SOC2_evidence_overview.pdf (redaction-friendly manifest).

Next steps:
- Wed 2027-05-26: Lauren to share one-page milestone summary (I asked her to join the thread).
- Tue 2027-06-01: 30-min procurement sync (Jonas will send calendar invite once we confirm attendees).
- Target commit decision: 2027-06-15 (aligned to your procurement window).

If helpful, Ben can run a short calibration test on our infra next week to validate the 95th percentile tail assumptions — Ben, can you confirm availability?

Thanks all — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
